CAMEO.gloss: engraving or carving in low relief on a stone
CAMEO.definition: Engraving or carving in low relief on a stone (as in a brooch or ring).

COME.gloss: move toward, travel toward something or somebody or approach something or somebody
COME.definition: Move toward, travel toward something or somebody or approach something or somebody.
COME.example: He came singing down the road.

COMA.gloss: a state of deep and often prolonged unconsciousness
COMA.definition: A state of deep and often prolonged unconsciousness; usually the result of disease or injury.

MACE.gloss: an official who carries a mace of office
MACE.definition: An official who carries a mace of office.

CAMO.gloss: fabric dyed with splotches of green and brown and black and tan
CAMO.definition: Fabric dyed with splotches of green and brown and black and tan; intended to make the wearer of a garment made of this fabric hard to distinguish from the background.

MAC.gloss: a waterproof raincoat made of rubberized fabric
MAC.definition: A waterproof raincoat made of rubberized fabric.

CAM.gloss: a rotating disk shaped to convert circular into linear motion
CAM.definition: A rotating disk shaped to convert circular into linear motion.

ACE.gloss: the smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number
ACE.definition: The smallest whole number or a numeral representing this number.
ACE.example: He has the one but will need a two and three to go with it.
